shadows.name: hero-screenshot-ambient
shadows.purpose: One diffuse violet haze beneath the real product screenshot.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Settled easing for landing-page state changes.

motion.name: hive-rest
motion.purpose: Quiet return from a hovered hive cell.

motion.name: hive-hover
motion.purpose: Quick fine-pointer response for the violet cell bloom.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Near-zero transitions and animations when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main writing action in the product's lavender-violet brand color.
components.html: Start writing
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 600 14px/1.25 IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out), box-shadow 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A quiet outlined route to desktop downloads beside the primary hero action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px/1.25 IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 200ms var(--ease-out), color 200ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--secondary); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-secondary { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

components.name: Sticky Navigation
components.description: The brand mark, compact section links, and 40px primary CTA in the persistent header.
components.html:
Write Me
FeaturesPrivacyDownloadsGitHub

components.css: .ds-site-header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--border) 80%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--background) 90%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-site-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; max-width: 88rem; height: 72px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 20px; } .ds-wordmark { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--foreground); font: 600 14px/1 IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark-mark { width: auto; height: 28px; flex: none; fill: currentColor; color: var(--primary); } .ds-nav-links { display: none; align-items: center; gap: 32px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 14px/1.4 IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-links a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-links a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-nav-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 600 14px/1.25 IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-site-nav { padding-left: 32px; padding-right: 32px; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; } } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-site-nav { padding-left: 48px; padding-right: 48px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-links a, .ds-nav-cta { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

components.name: Platform Download Row
components.description: A ruled platform entry with compatibility copy and one or more primary installer actions.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-download-row { display: grid; gap: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 28px 0; } .ds-download-title { margin: 0; color: var(--foreground); font: 500 20px/1.3 IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-download-meta { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 14px/1.5 IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif; } .ds-download-actions { display: grid; gap: 12px; } .ds-download-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 14px/1.25 IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-download-action:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-download-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-download-row { padding-top: 32px; padding-bottom: 32px; } .ds-download-actions { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-download-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.72fr) minmax(0, 1.28fr); align-items: center; gap: 40px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-download-action { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

components.name: Hive Field Cell
components.description: One decorative violet hexagon from the hero lattice, accessible as hidden background artwork.
components.css: .ds-hive-cell { position: relative; display: block; width: 72px; height: 82.8px; flex: none; clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 25%, 100% 75%, 50% 100%, 0% 75%, 0% 25%); transition: filter 360ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-hive-cell::before { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--emphasis) 22%, transparent); content: ""; } .ds-hive-cell::after { position: absolute; inset: 4px; clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 25%, 100% 75%, 50% 100%, 0% 75%, 0% 25%); background: var(--background); content: ""; transition: background-color 320ms var(--ease-out); } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-hive-cell:hover { z-index: 1; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 8px color-mix(in oklch, var(--emphasis) 76%, transparent)) drop-shadow(0 0 28px color-mix(in oklch, var(--emphasis) 54%, transparent)) drop-shadow(0 0 58px color-mix(in oklch, var(--emphasis) 25%, transparent)); transition-duration: 60ms; } .ds-hive-cell:hover::after { background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--emphasis) 18%, var(--background)); transition-duration: 60ms; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hive-cell, .ds-hive-cell::after { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

narrative.overview:
Write Me's landing page is an ink-black field for people who write to think. Warm silver keeps the reading voice calm; the product's own lavender-violet marks the action and the thinking space. The first view shows the actual app before the copy asks the visitor to believe anything.

An outlined hex lattice holds the hero together. Its quiet violet lines brighten into one distinct halo when a fine pointer crosses a cell; after the hero, the page opens into ruled lists, generous intervals, and flat tonal sections. The surrounding structure sells the feeling of care without fake proof or clutter.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ink, warm silver type, and lavender-violet as the single brand signal.
The real Write Me workspace is the hero's product proof.
A subtle honeycomb field earns attention through hover, not motion loops.
Open ruled sections and generous vertical rhythm replace a grid of feature cards.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Use Write Me's purple for the action, the highlighted headline, and the hive; green does not replace it as the primary brand color.

rules.name: The One Bloom Rule
rules.body: Keep resting cell outlines quiet and reserve the pronounced violet bloom for the hovered cell. Respect reduced-motion preferences and do not run ambient animation loops.

dos: Do place the brand purple on the primary CTA, the phrase accent, and the hive glow.
Do keep the lavender lattice low-contrast until a fine-pointer hover.
Do let thin dividers, generous spacing, and the real editor screen carry the supporting story.
donts: Don't replace the brand's purple with green as the primary action or hive hue.
Don't use raw Tailwind palette classes; consume semantic theme tokens.
Don't let the idle hive lines obscure the copy or real product screenshot.
